t: WEMO - Wikipedia
s: August 26, 2025 - WEMO, a subsidiary of Belkin, are a series of products from Belkin that enable users to control home electronics remotely. The product suite includes electrical plugs, motion sensors, light switches, cameras, light bulbs, and a mobile app.

t: Wemo Smart Home
s: Wemo by Belkin creates and curates a collection of smart household technology which work together to make your house a home. No matter how smart our technology gets, we know that home should be human, so we design everything to be simple, intuitive and non-intrusive.
